title: 金谷园
author: 杜牧
note: 【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。；【金谷园】唐代杜牧所作的诗。
tr: 繁华事散逐香尘。流水无情草自春。日暮东风怨啼鸟。落花犹似坠楼人。
appr: 《金谷园》是唐代杜牧所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「繁华事散逐香尘。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《金谷园》历代传诵不衰，是杜牧诗歌风格的集中体现。

bg: 《金谷园》为唐代杜牧所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者杜牧在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《金谷园》主旨在于描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。；写闺阁情思，抒发女子的思念与幽怨。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代杜牧的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Past grandeur has dissolved, gone with the fragrant dust.
Heartless waters flow on, while grass turns green each spring.
At dusk the east wind bears the plaintive cry of birds.
Fallen blossoms still recall the girl who fell from the tower.

title: 丹青引赠曹将军霸
author: 杜甫
body: 褒公鄂公毛发动英姿飒爽来酣战。
note: 《丹青引赠曹将军霸》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【丹青引赠曹将军霸】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 將軍魏武之子孫，於今爲庶爲清門。英雄割據雖已了，文彩風流猶尚存。學書初學衛夫人，但恨無過王右軍。丹青不知老將至，富貴於我如浮雲。開元之中常引見，承恩數上南熏殿。凌煙功臣少顏色，將軍下筆開生面。良相頭上進賢冠，猛將腰間大羽箭。褒公鄂公毛髮動英姿颯爽來酣戰。先帝天馬玉花驄，畫工如山貌不同。是日牽來赤墀下，迥立閶闔生長風。詔謂將軍拂絹素，意匠慘澹經營中。斯須九重真龍出，一洗萬古凡馬空。玉花却在御榻上，榻上庭前屹相向。至尊含笑催賜金，圉人太僕皆惆悵。弟子韓幹早入室，亦能畫馬窮殊相。幹惟畫肉不畫骨，忍使驊騮氣凋喪。將軍畫善蓋有神，必逢佳士亦寫真。即今飄泊干戈際，屢貌尋常行路人。途窮反遭俗眼白，世上未有如公貧。但看古來盛名下，終日坎壈纏其身。
appr: 《丹青引赠曹将军霸》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共39句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《丹青引赠曹将军霸》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: General, you are a descendant of the Martial Emperor of Wei,
Yet now you live as a commoner in a humble household.
The hero's conquests of old have long since passed away,
But the grace of letters and art still lingers in the world.
When you first learned calligraphy, you studied under Lady Wei,
Yet regretted you could not surpass the mastery of Wang Xizhi.
Absorbed in painting, you knew not old age was approaching,
Wealth and rank to you were but floating clouds above.
During the Kaiyuan era you were often summoned to audience,
Receiving imperial favor, ascending Nanxun Hall time and again.
The portraits of meritorious officials in Lingyan Pavilion had faded,
But your brush brought them back to life with fresh vitality.
Wise chancellors wear the Jinxian cap upon their brows,
Valiant generals bear great feathered arrows at their waists.
The Dukes of Bao and E seem to stir, their hair and beards alive, bold and dashing as if about to charge into fierce battle.
The late emperor's heavenly steed was named Yuhuacong,
Countless painters had failed to capture its true spirit.
That day the horse was led below the crimson palace steps,
Standing proud before the palace gates, stirring a mighty wind.
The emperor decreed you spread silk and prepare to paint,
As you labored in conception, planning with deep devotion.
In an instant a true dragon-steed emerged upon the silk,
Sweeping away the vulgar look of common horses through the ages.
The painted Yuhuacong now hung above the imperial couch,
While the real horse stood facing it across the courtyard.
His Majesty smiled and urged that gold be bestowed,
As grooms and stable officials looked on in dismay.
Your disciple Han Gan had long mastered your art,
Able too to paint horses in all their varied forms.
Yet Han Gan painted only flesh, not the bone within,
Allowing the noble spirit of fine steeds to wither away.
General, your paintings excel because they catch the divine spark,
And you would paint true portraits of worthy gentlemen you met.
But now in these troubled times of war and wandering,
You are forced to paint likenesses of common passersby.
Reduced to hardship, you meet with cold scorn from vulgar eyes,
No one in this world endures poverty as deep as yours.
But look at all those who have borne great fame since ancient times—
Frustration and misfortune have always dogged their days.

baihua_lines: 曹将军本是魏武帝曹操的后代子孙，
到如今却沦为平民，成了清寒人家。
先祖英雄割据的伟业虽已成了往事，
但文采风流的遗韵至今还留存世间。
你初学书法时师从卫夫人，
只遗憾没能超过王羲之的书法造诣。
潜心于丹青绘画竟不知老之将至，
荣华富贵在我看来就如天上的浮云。
开元年间你常常被玄宗皇帝引见，
承蒙恩宠多次登上南熏殿侍奉君王。
凌烟阁上的功臣画像颜色已经暗淡，
将军你下笔重绘让功臣们别开生面。
贤良的宰相头上戴着进贤冠，
勇猛的将军腰间佩着大羽箭。
褒公鄂公的毛发仿佛都在颤动，英姿飒爽好像正要前来酣战。
先帝的御马名叫玉花骢，
无数画工画它都画不出真神采。
这天马被牵到赤墀台阶之下，
昂首屹立在宫门之前威风凛凛。
皇帝下诏命将军你展开素绢作画，
你精心构思费尽心力布局经营。
顷刻间九重真龙般的骏马跃然绢上，
一下把万古以来凡马的俗态一扫空。
玉花骢的画像反倒挂在了御榻之上，
榻上画马与庭前真马屹然相对而立。
皇帝含笑催促下人赏赐黄金，
养马的官员们都在一旁怅然若失。
你的弟子韩干早已经得到真传，
也能画出骏马各种不同的形态。
韩干画马只画皮肉不画风骨，
竟让千里马的神气凋丧全无。
将军的画精妙之处在于有神韵，
遇到佳士名士也必定为他们写真。
可如今在战乱纷飞的岁月里漂泊，
反倒常常去画普通的过路行人。
走投无路时反遭俗人冷眼相待，
世上再没有人像你这样清贫了。
请看自古以来那些负有盛名的人，
一生都坎坷失意困顿缠身。
baihua: 曹将军本是魏武帝曹操的后代子孙，到如今却沦为平民，成了清寒人家。先祖英雄割据的伟业虽已成了往事，但文采风流的遗韵至今还留存世间。你初学书法时师从卫夫人，只遗憾没能超过王羲之的书法造诣。潜心于丹青绘画竟不知老之将至，荣华富贵在我看来就如天上的浮云。开元年间你常常被玄宗皇帝引见，承蒙恩宠多次登上南熏殿侍奉君王。凌烟阁上的功臣画像颜色已经暗淡，将军你下笔重绘让功臣们别开生面。贤良的宰相头上戴着进贤冠，勇猛的将军腰间佩着大羽箭。褒公鄂公的毛发仿佛都在颤动，英姿飒爽好像正要前来酣战。先帝的御马名叫玉花骢，无数画工画它都画不出真神采。这天马被牵到赤墀台阶之下，昂首屹立在宫门之前威风凛凛。皇帝下诏命将军你展开素绢作画，你精心构思费尽心力布局经营。顷刻间九重真龙般的骏马跃然绢上，一下把万古以来凡马的俗态一扫空。玉花骢的画像反倒挂在了御榻之上，榻上画马与庭前真马屹然相对而立。皇帝含笑催促下人赏赐黄金，养马的官员们都在一旁怅然若失。你的弟子韩干早已经得到真传，也能画出骏马各种不同的形态。韩干画马只画皮肉不画风骨，竟让千里马的神气凋丧全无。将军的画精妙之处在于有神韵，遇到佳士名士也必定为他们写真。可如今在战乱纷飞的岁月里漂泊，反倒常常去画普通的过路行人。走投无路时反遭俗人冷眼相待，世上再没有人像你这样清贫了。请看自古以来那些负有盛名的人，一生都坎坷失意困顿缠身。
en_lines: General, you are a descendant of the Martial Emperor of Wei,
Yet now you live as a commoner in a humble household.
The hero's conquests of old have long since passed away,
But the grace of letters and art still lingers in the world.
When you first learned calligraphy, you studied under Lady Wei,
Yet regretted you could not surpass the mastery of Wang Xizhi.
Absorbed in painting, you knew not old age was approaching,
Wealth and rank to you were but floating clouds above.
During the Kaiyuan era you were often summoned to audience,
Receiving imperial favor, ascending Nanxun Hall time and again.
The portraits of meritorious officials in Lingyan Pavilion had faded,
But your brush brought them back to life with fresh vitality.
Wise chancellors wear the Jinxian cap upon their brows,
Valiant generals bear great feathered arrows at their waists.
The Dukes of Bao and E seem to stir, their hair and beards alive, bold and dashing as if about to charge into fierce battle.
The late emperor's heavenly steed was named Yuhuacong,
Countless painters had failed to capture its true spirit.
That day the horse was led below the crimson palace steps,
Standing proud before the palace gates, stirring a mighty wind.
The emperor decreed you spread silk and prepare to paint,
As you labored in conception, planning with deep devotion.
In an instant a true dragon-steed emerged upon the silk,
Sweeping away the vulgar look of common horses through the ages.
The painted Yuhuacong now hung above the imperial couch,
While the real horse stood facing it across the courtyard.
His Majesty smiled and urged that gold be bestowed,
As grooms and stable officials looked on in dismay.
Your disciple Han Gan had long mastered your art,
Able too to paint horses in all their varied forms.
Yet Han Gan painted only flesh, not the bone within,
Allowing the noble spirit of fine steeds to wither away.
General, your paintings excel because they catch the divine spark,
And you would paint true portraits of worthy gentlemen you met.
But now in these troubled times of war and wandering,
You are forced to paint likenesses of common passersby.
Reduced to hardship, you meet with cold scorn from vulgar eyes,
No one in this world endures poverty as deep as yours.
But look at all those who have borne great fame since ancient times—
Frustration and misfortune have always dogged their days.

title: 丽人行
author: 杜甫
note: 《丽人行》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【丽人行】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 三月三日天氣新，長安水邊多麗人。態濃意遠淑且真，肌理細膩骨肉勻。繡羅衣裳照暮春，蹙金孔雀銀麒麟。頭上何所有，翠微㔩葉垂鬢脣。背後何所見，珠壓腰衱穩稱身。就中雲幕椒房親，賜名大國虢與秦。紫駝之峰出翠釜，水精之盤行素鱗。犀箸厭飫久未下，鑾刀縷切空紛綸。黃門飛鞚不動塵，御廚絡繹送八珍。簫鼓哀吟感鬼神，賓從雜遝實要津。後來鞍馬何逡巡，當軒下馬入錦茵。楊花雪落覆白蘋，青鳥飛去銜紅巾。炙手可熱勢絕倫，慎莫近前丞相嗔。
appr: 《丽人行》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共26句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《丽人行》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

theme: 《丽人行》主旨在于抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代杜甫的代表性作品之一。
en_body: On the third day of the third month, the air is fresh and fine,
By the waters of Chang'an many lovely ladies gather.
Their bearing rich, their spirits distant, virtuous and true,
Their skin smooth and delicate, their frames well-proportioned.
Embroidered silk gowns glow in the light of late spring,
With golden-thread peacocks and silver unicorns stitched upon them.
What adorns their heads?
Kingfisher-feather hairpieces dangling at their temples.
What is seen from behind?
Pearl-weighted sashes fitting perfectly around their waists.
Among them are the kin of the Pepper Chamber behind cloud curtains,
The ladies of Guo and Qin, granted titles of great fiefs.
Humps of purple camel are served from pots of jade-green,
While crystal platters bear white fish fresh and fine.
Rhinoceros-horn chopsticks are lifted, but they have long grown weary of rich food,
And the fine slices cut with jeweled knives are all prepared in vain.
Palace eunuchs gallop on horseback without stirring dust,
As imperial chefs bring delicacies in endless streams.
Flutes and drums sound mournful airs that move the spirits,
While guests and retainers throng the roads, blocking the way.
Last comes a rider on horseback, how leisurely his pace,
Dismounting before the pavilion to step upon brocade cushions.
Willow catkins fall like snow, covering the white duckweed,
As blue birds fly off bearing red scarves in their beaks.
His power burns hot, his influence beyond compare,
Take care not to draw too near—the Prime Minister may rage.

baihua_lines: 三月三上巳节天气清新宜人，
长安曲江水边聚集了许多美人。
她们姿态浓艳、意韵悠远，端庄而又天真，
肌肤细腻光滑，身材匀称合度。
绫罗绣花的衣裳映照着暮春景色，
上面用金线绣着孔雀、银线绣着麒麟。
她们头上戴的是什么呢？
翡翠做的㔩叶垂在鬓角边。
她们背后能看到什么呢？
珍珠缀压的裙腰腰带贴身合体。
其中有云幕般的后妃亲戚，
就是被赐名虢国夫人和秦国夫人的杨贵妃姐妹。
翡翠锅中盛出紫驼峰肉做的珍馐，
水晶盘里端着洁白的鲜鱼。
她们举着犀牛角筷子却早吃腻了，久久不肯下筷，
銮刀细切的菜肴白白忙乱了一场。
宦官骑马飞驰而来却不扬起一点尘土，
御厨络绎不绝地送来山珍海味。
箫鼓的哀乐声凄婉动人，能感动鬼神，
宾客随从众多，挤满了交通要道。
最后骑马来的那人神态多么从容不迫，
到门前才下马，踏上锦绣地毯。
杨花像雪一样飘落覆盖了白苹，
青鸟飞去衔来地上的红手帕。
杨家权势滔天、气焰逼人，无人能比，
千万不要走近前去，惹得丞相发怒。

title: 佳人
author: 杜甫
note: 《佳人》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【佳人】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 絕代有佳人，幽居在空谷。自云良家子，零落依草木。關中昔喪敗，兄弟遭殺戮。官高何足論，不得收骨肉。世情惡衰歇，萬事隨轉燭。夫壻輕薄兒，新人已如玉。合昏尚知時，鴛鴦不獨宿。但見新人笑，那聞舊人哭。在山泉水清，出山泉水濁。侍婢賣珠回，牽蘿補茅屋。摘花不插髮，采柏動盈匊。天寒翠袖薄，日暮倚修竹。

en_body: There lives a lady of unmatched beauty,
Dwelling alone in an empty mountain valley.
She says she was born of a good family,
Now fallen and withered, clinging to grass and trees.
When the Guanzhong region fell to chaos and war,
Her brothers were slain in the slaughter.
What use was their high official rank?
She could not even gather their bones for burial.
The world's way despises those who fall from fortune,
All things turn like a candle flame flickering in the wind.

baihua_lines: 有一位举世无双的美人，
独自隐居在空旷的山谷之中。
她自称本是良家女子，
如今漂泊沦落，寄居在山林草木之间。
当年关中地区遭遇战乱，
她的兄弟们都惨遭杀戮。
官位再高又有什么值得说的呢？
连亲人的尸骨都无法收殓安葬。
世态人情总是厌恶衰败失势的人，
世间万事就像随风转动的烛火一样飘摇不定。
她的丈夫是个轻薄薄情之人，
又娶了美貌如玉的新夫人。
合欢花尚且知道朝开夜合的时节，
鸳鸯鸟也从不独自栖宿。
那负心人只看得见新人的欢笑，
哪里听得到旧人的哭泣。
在山中的泉水是清澈的，
流出山外泉水就变得浑浊了。
侍女变卖了珍珠回来，
牵起藤萝修补破旧的茅屋。
她摘下鲜花却不插在发上，
采摘柏叶时常常捧满一掬。
天气寒冷时她的翠袖显得分外单薄，
日暮时分她倚着修长的竹子久久伫立。

author: 杜甫

title: 兵车行
author: 杜甫
body: 君不闻汉家山东二百州，
note: 《兵车行》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【兵车行】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 車轔轔，馬蕭蕭，行人弓箭各在腰。耶孃妻子走相送，塵埃不見咸陽橋。牽衣頓足闌道哭，哭聲直上干雲霄。道傍過者問行人，行人但云點行頻。或從十五北防河，便至四十西營田。去時里正與裹頭，歸來頭白還戍邊。邊亭流血成海水，武皇開邊意未已。君不聞漢家山東二百州，千村萬落生荆杞。縱有健婦把鋤犂，禾生隴畝無東西。況復秦兵耐苦戰，被驅不異犬與雞。長者雖有問，役夫敢申恨。且如今年冬，未休關西卒。縣官急索租，租稅從何出？信知生男惡，反是生女好。生女猶是嫁比鄰，生男埋沒隨百草。君不見青海頭，古來白骨無人收。新鬼煩冤舊鬼哭，天陰雨濕聲啾啾。

en_body: Chariots rattle and rumble,
Horses neigh and whinny,
Each marching soldier wears bow and arrows at his waist.
Fathers, mothers, wives, children run to see them off,
Dust clouds hide the Xianyang Bridge from sight.
They cling to clothes, stamp feet, block the road and weep,
Their cries rising straight up to pierce the clouds.
A passerby on the road asks the soldiers what this means,
They only say conscription calls come far too often.
Some were sent north to guard the Yellow River at fifteen,
And at forty still garrison the western frontier farms.
When they left, the village elder wrapped their headcloths for them,
They returned white-haired, yet must go back to guard the borders.
At the frontier posts blood has flowed to form a sea,
Yet the Martial Emperor's ambition to expand remains unquenched.
Have you not heard? In the two hundred prefectures east of Huashan,
A thousand villages, ten thousand hamlets grow thorns and brambles.
Even where sturdy wives grip ploughs and hoes to till the fields,
The grain grows wild across the ridges, no east or west.
And the soldiers of Qin, hardy and used to bitter battle,
Are driven about no differently from dogs or chickens.
Though an elder like you asks these questions,
How dare we conscripted men voice our resentment?
Take this winter, for instance—
The soldiers from Guanxi have not been released.
County officials press urgently for rent and taxes,
But where are these taxes to come from?
Now I truly see it is ill fortune to bear sons,
Far better to give birth to daughters instead.
Daughters can still marry neighbors close at hand,
Sons lie buried and forgotten among the wild grasses.
Have you not seen by the shores of Qinghai Lake?
Since ancient times white bones have lain uncollected.
New ghosts tormented by wrongs, old ghosts weeping,
In dark, rainy weather their wailing sounds fill the air.

background: 《兵车行》为唐代杜甫所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者杜甫在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Chariots rattle and rumble,
Horses neigh and whinny,
Each marching soldier wears bow and arrows at his waist.
Fathers, mothers, wives, children run to see them off,
Dust clouds hide the Xianyang Bridge from sight.
They cling to clothes, stamp feet, block the road and weep,
Their cries rising straight up to pierce the clouds.
A passerby on the road asks the soldiers what this means,
They only say conscription calls come far too often.
Some were sent north to guard the Yellow River at fifteen,
And at forty still garrison the western frontier farms.
When they left, the village elder wrapped their headcloths for them,
They returned white-haired, yet must go back to guard the borders.
At the frontier posts blood has flowed to form a sea,
Yet the Martial Emperor's ambition to expand remains unquenched.
Have you not heard? In the two hundred prefectures east of Huashan,
A thousand villages, ten thousand hamlets grow thorns and brambles.
Even where sturdy wives grip ploughs and hoes to till the fields,
The grain grows wild across the ridges, no east or west.
And the soldiers of Qin, hardy and used to bitter battle,
Are driven about no differently from dogs or chickens.
Though an elder like you asks these questions,
How dare we conscripted men voice our resentment?
Take this winter, for instance—
The soldiers from Guanxi have not been released.
County officials press urgently for rent and taxes,
But where are these taxes to come from?
Now I truly see it is ill fortune to bear sons,
Far better to give birth to daughters instead.
Daughters can still marry neighbors close at hand,
Sons lie buried and forgotten among the wild grasses.
Have you not seen by the shores of Qinghai Lake?
Since ancient times white bones have lain uncollected.
New ghosts tormented by wrongs, old ghosts weeping,
In dark, rainy weather their wailing sounds fill the air.
baihua_lines: 战车辚辚作响，
战马萧萧嘶鸣，
出征的士兵个个把弓箭挎在腰间。
父母妻子儿女奔跑着赶来相送，
扬起的尘土遮天蔽日，连咸阳桥都看不见了。
亲人们牵衣跺脚拦在路上痛哭，
悲苦的哭声直冲云霄。
路旁经过的人问出征的士兵怎么回事，
士兵只说朝廷征兵太过频繁。
有的人十五岁就被征到黄河以北驻防，
到了四十岁还要去西部屯田垦荒。
离开家乡时里长还替他们裹上头巾，
回来时头发都白了还要再去戍守边疆。
边境上战士流的血多得汇成了海水，
可汉武帝开拓疆土的意愿仍未停止。
你难道没听说汉家华山以东的两百多个州，
千千万万的村落都长满了荆棘野草。
就算有健壮的妇人拿着锄头犁地耕种，
田地里的庄稼也长得杂乱无章，分不清东西。
更何况关中的士兵能吃苦耐战，
被驱使着就跟鸡狗没什么两样。
虽然老先生您向我询问，
我们这些服役的人又怎敢诉说心中怨恨？
就说今年冬天吧，
关西的士兵还没有休整。
县官衙役急着催交租税，
可这租税又从哪里出呢？
现在才知道生男孩是件坏事，
反倒不如生女孩好。
生了女孩还能嫁给近邻，
生了男孩只会战死沙场埋没在荒草之间。
你难道没看见青海边的古战场上，
自古以来战死的白骨就没人掩埋收殓。
新鬼含冤烦愁，旧鬼在哭泣，
阴雨天湿冷的时候总能听到啾啾的鬼哭声。

title: 别房太尉墓
author: 杜甫
note: 《别房太尉墓》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【别房太尉墓】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 他鄉復行役，駐馬別孤墳。近淚無乾土，低空有斷雲。對碁陪謝傅，把劒覓徐君。唯見林花落，鸎啼送客聞。
appr: 《别房太尉墓》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《别房太尉墓》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: Once more I travel on official errands in a strange land,
And rein my horse to bid farewell at your lonely grave.
My tears have fallen so that no dry earth remains nearby,
Beneath a low sky strewn with broken clouds.
Playing chess with you was like accompanying Xie An of old,
Now bearing my sword I come, like Jizha seeking Xu's tomb.
Only the forest blossoms are seen falling,
As orioles cry out, seeing off this departing guest.

baihua_lines: 我又在他乡奔波赶路，
停下马来拜别你的孤坟。
泪水洒下，坟前近旁都没有了干土，
低低的天空中飘着片片断云。
当年与你对棋，如同陪谢安下棋般风雅，
如今我持剑而来，像季札挂剑一样寻觅你的坟茔。
只看见林花纷纷飘落，
黄莺的啼叫声声，仿佛在为送别我这个客人而悲鸣。

title: 古柏行
author: 杜甫
note: 《古柏行》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【古柏行】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 孔明廟前有老柏，柯如青銅根如石。霜皮溜雨四十圍，黛色參天二千尺。君臣已與時際會，樹木猶爲人愛惜。雲來氣接巫峽長，月出寒通雪山白。憶昨路繞錦亭東，先主武侯同閟宮。崔嵬枝幹郊原古，窈窕丹青戶牖空。落落盤踞雖得地，冥冥孤高多烈風。扶持自是神明力，正直原因造化功。大廈如傾要梁棟，萬牛回首丘山重。不露文章世已驚，未辭剪伐誰能送。苦心豈免容螻蟻，香葉終經宿鸞鳳。志士幽人莫怨嗟，古來材大難爲用。

en_body: Before the Temple of Kongming stands an ancient cypress,
Its boughs like green bronze, its roots firm as stone.
Its frost-white bark, washed by rain, spans forty spans around,
Its dark green crown pierces the heavens two thousand feet high.
Lord and minister met in their time, a fated union,
And even this tree is cherished and protected by people still.
When clouds come, their breath joins the long mists of Wu Gorge,
When the moon rises, its cold reaches the white snow mountains.
I remember when my road wound east of the Brocade Pavilion,
Where the First Lord and Wuhou share a single shrine.
Its towering boughs make the countryside seem ancient,
While within painted halls and windows lie silent and empty.
Rooted firm and deep, it holds its place in the earth,
Yet soaring high and lone, it faces fierce winds constantly.
That it stands upheld must be the power of divine spirits,
Its uprightness is the very work of Creation itself.
If a great hall should topple, it needs just such beams as this,
But ten thousand oxen turn away—for it weighs as much as hills.
Without displaying vain ornament, it already amazes the world,
It does not shrink from being cut, yet who can carry it away?
Its bitter heart cannot avoid the ants that bore within,
Yet its fragrant leaves have sheltered phoenixes at rest.
Let aspiring men and recluses sigh and complain no more—
Since ancient times, great timber is rarely put to use.

background: 《古柏行》为唐代杜甫所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者杜甫在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Before the Temple of Kongming stands an ancient cypress,
Its boughs like green bronze, its roots firm as stone.
Its frost-white bark, washed by rain, spans forty spans around,
Its dark green crown pierces the heavens two thousand feet high.
Lord and minister met in their time, a fated union,
And even this tree is cherished and protected by people still.
When clouds come, their breath joins the long mists of Wu Gorge,
When the moon rises, its cold reaches the white snow mountains.
I remember when my road wound east of the Brocade Pavilion,
Where the First Lord and Wuhou share a single shrine.
Its towering boughs make the countryside seem ancient,
While within painted halls and windows lie silent and empty.
Rooted firm and deep, it holds its place in the earth,
Yet soaring high and lone, it faces fierce winds constantly.
That it stands upheld must be the power of divine spirits,
Its uprightness is the very work of Creation itself.
If a great hall should topple, it needs just such beams as this,
But ten thousand oxen turn away—for it weighs as much as hills.
Without displaying vain ornament, it already amazes the world,
It does not shrink from being cut, yet who can carry it away?
Its bitter heart cannot avoid the ants that bore within,
Yet its fragrant leaves have sheltered phoenixes at rest.
Let aspiring men and recluses sigh and complain no more—
Since ancient times, great timber is rarely put to use.
baihua_lines: 孔明庙前生长着一棵古老的柏树，
树枝如青铜般坚硬，树根像磐石一样牢固。
树皮洁白润滑经得住风雨，树身粗达四十围，
深青的树冠高耸入云，足足有二千尺高。
刘备与诸葛亮君臣遇合，顺应时势风云际会，
就连这棵树木也至今被后人爱惜保护。
云气飘来，与巫峡的浩渺之气相接相连，
明月升起时，寒意直逼雪山，通体洁白。
想起前些天我路过锦亭东面，
先主刘备和武侯诸葛亮同在一座祠庙中。
古柏高大的枝干挺立在郊原之上，更显苍古，
庙内幽深的彩绘门窗空寂冷落。
古柏盘根错节虽占得了好地势，
可孤高挺拔直上云霄，不断遭受烈风吹袭。
它能挺立不倒自然是神明在护持助力，
它的正直端原本是造化赋予的神功。
大厦如果将要倾倒，就需要这样的栋梁之材，
可这古柏重如丘山，万头牛也拉不动，只得回头望。
它不显华美的文采，就已让世人惊叹，
虽不避砍伐修剪，可又有谁能把它运走？
柏心味苦，难免招来蝼蚁蛀蚀寄居，
柏叶清香，终究会引来鸾凤栖息留宿。
有志之士和隐逸高人不要埋怨叹息，
自古以来大材都难以被重用。

title: 咏怀古迹·其一
author: 杜甫
note: 《咏怀古迹·其一》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【咏怀古迹·其一】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 支离东北风尘际，飘泊西南天地间。三峡楼台淹日月，五溪衣服共云山。羯胡事主终无赖，词客哀时且未还。庾信平生最萧瑟，暮年诗赋动江关。
appr: 《咏怀古迹·其一》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《咏怀古迹·其一》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

theme: 《咏怀古迹·其一》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代杜甫的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Scattered and torn amid the dust of war in the northeast,
I drift and wander through the heavens and earth of the southwest.
Among the Three Gorges, terraces and towers detain the days and months,
Among the Five Streams I share the clouded hills with tribes in strange dress.
The Jie barbarians who served their lord proved faithless in the end,
While poets mourn the times and still cannot return home.
Yu Xin's life was one of utter desolation,
Yet in his later years his poems and odes stirred the whole river land.

庾信一生最为凄凉萧瑟，
到了晚年他的诗赋震动了江关大地。

title: 咏怀古迹·其三
author: 杜甫
note: 【春风】春日和风，常喻恩泽、喜悦或美好时光。；【咏怀古迹·其三】唐代杜甫所作的诗。

en_body: A thousand mountains, ten thousand valleys race toward Jingmen,
The village where Lady Mingfei once grew up still remains.
Once she left the purple palace, she faced the northern deserts,
Leaving only her green grave to face the dusk alone.
How could a painting capture that spring-breeze face?
Her jade pendants ring in vain as her soul returns on moonlit nights.
For a thousand years the pipa plays songs of the frontier,
And clearly in the melody her sorrows are told.

author: 杜甫

en_body: When leaves fall and wither, I know well Song Yu's sorrow,
His graceful and refined spirit is also a teacher to me.
Gazing across a thousand autumns, I shed tears,
For we share the same desolation, though born in different times.
Rivers and mountains remain, his old home lingers, his writings live on,
The tale of clouds and rain on the waste terrace—was it merely a dream?
Most sadly the palaces of Chu have all crumbled to dust,
Yet boatmen still point out the site and doubt it to this day.

en_body: The Lord of Shu marched against Wu and came to the Three Gorges,
And it was in Yong'an Palace that his life came to an end.
His emerald standards can still be imagined in the empty hills,
His jade halls have vanished, leaving only a temple in the wilds.
Water cranes nest in the pines and firs of the ancient shrine,
Old village men come to offer sacrifice at summer and winter festivals.
The shrine of Marquis Wu stands always close at hand,
Lord and minister, joined in death, share the same rites to this day.

title: 哀江头
author: 杜甫
note: 《哀江头》是杜甫的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【哀江头】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 少陵野老吞聲哭，春日潛行曲江曲。江頭宮殿鎖千門，細柳新蒲爲誰綠。憶昔霓旌下南苑，苑中萬物生顏色。昭陽殿裏第一人，同輦隨君侍君側。輦前才人帶弓箭，白馬嚼齧黃金勒。翻身向天仰射雲，一箭正墜雙飛翼。明眸皓齒今何在，血污遊魂歸不得。清渭東流劒閣深，去住彼此無消息。人生有情淚霑臆，江水江花豈終極。黃昏胡騎塵滿城，欲往城南忘南北。

en_body: I, the old man of Shaoling, weep silent, choking tears,
And steal along the winding banks of Qujiang in spring.
The riverside palaces have locked their thousand gates,
For whom do the slender willows and fresh rushes turn green?
I recall when the emperor's rainbow standards came to the South Park,
And all things in the garden glowed with brilliant color.
The first lady of Zhaoyang Hall, most favored of all,
Rode in the same carriage, attending at the sovereign's side.
Before the carriage, palace ladies carried bows and arrows,
Their white horses champing bits of yellow gold.
They turned and shot upward toward the clouds,
And with one arrow brought down the pair of flying birds.
Where are those bright eyes and white teeth now?
Her wandering soul, stained with blood, cannot return.
The clear Wei flows east, the Sword Pavilion stretches deep and far,
The gone and the living send no word to one another.
Human hearts have feelings, and tears stain the breast,
But river waters and river blossoms—how can they ever end?
At dusk dust fills the city from the barbarian riders,
I try to go south of the city, but lose my way, north from south.

春日里偷偷地走到曲江的角落。
曲江头的宫殿紧锁着千门万户，
细嫩的柳枝、新生的蒲草究竟为谁而绿？
忆想当年玄宗皇帝的仪仗来到南苑，
苑中万物都焕发出艳丽的光彩。
昭阳殿里最受宠爱的杨贵妃，
同车随驾侍奉在皇帝身旁。
车辇前的女才人带着弓箭，
白色的骏马咬着黄金做的马勒。
翻身仰天仰面射向云端，
一箭射落了那双飞的比翼鸟。
明眸皓齿的美人如今在哪里呢？
鲜血玷污了游魂，早已归不得了。
清渭水向东流去，剑阁深远绵长，
一去一留彼此再没有消息。
人是有感情的，想到这些不免泪洒胸膛，
江水流淌、江花开放，哪里会有尽头？
黄昏时分，胡人的骑兵扬起满城尘土，
我想往城南走去，却分不清南北方向。

author: 杜甫

en_body: On the walls of Chang'an perches a white-headed crow,
Flying to the Yanqiu Gate by night to call and cry.
It flies on to peck at the great roofs of noble houses,
While the great officials beneath flee the barbarians.
Golden whips are snapped in two, nine imperial horses die,
Flesh and blood cannot wait for one another in the flight.
At the waist of one young prince hang jade and coral pendants,
Poor boy—he weeps and hides at the corner of the road.
Asked his name, he will not tell,
Only says he suffers hardship and begs to be made a slave.
For a hundred days he has fled through thorns and brambles,
No patch of skin on his body remains unbroken.
All descendants of Emperor Gao have high noble noses,
Dragon seed naturally differs from ordinary men.
Jackals and wolves hold the city, dragons roam the wilds,
Young prince, guard well your precious body worth a thousand gold.
I dare not speak long at the crossroads,
But pause a moment for your sake by the roadside.
Last night the east wind carried the smell of blood,
Camels from the east crowd through the old capital.
The northern soldiers were once skilled warriors,
How brave they were then—how foolish they seem now.
I have heard in secret that the emperor has passed the throne,
And his virtue has won the submission of the southern chieftains.
The Huamen tribesmen cut their faces, swearing to wipe out our shame,
But speak not of this—spies listen and lie in wait.
Alas, young prince, be not careless,
The auspicious spirit of the Five Imperial Tombs will never fade.

en_translation: On the walls of Chang'an perches a white-headed crow,
Flying to the Yanqiu Gate by night to call and cry.
It flies on to peck at the great roofs of noble houses,
While the great officials beneath flee the barbarians.
Golden whips are snapped in two, nine imperial horses die,
Flesh and blood cannot wait for one another in the flight.
At the waist of one young prince hang jade and coral pendants,
Poor boy—he weeps and hides at the corner of the road.
Asked his name, he will not tell,
Only says he suffers hardship and begs to be made a slave.
For a hundred days he has fled through thorns and brambles,
No patch of skin on his body remains unbroken.
All descendants of Emperor Gao have high noble noses,
Dragon seed naturally differs from ordinary men.
Jackals and wolves hold the city, dragons roam the wilds,
Young prince, guard well your precious body worth a thousand gold.
I dare not speak long at the crossroads,
But pause a moment for your sake by the roadside.
Last night the east wind carried the smell of blood,
Camels from the east crowd through the old capital.
The northern soldiers were once skilled warriors,
How brave they were then—how foolish they seem now.
I have heard in secret that the emperor has passed the throne,
And his virtue has won the submission of the southern chieftains.
The Huamen tribesmen cut their faces, swearing to wipe out our shame,
But speak not of this—spies listen and lie in wait.
Alas, young prince, be not careless,
The auspicious spirit of the Five Imperial Tombs will never fade.
baihua_lines: 长安城头站着一只白头乌鸦，
夜里飞到延秋门上呱呱啼叫。
它又飞到人家的大屋上啄着屋顶，
屋里的达官贵人都逃跑躲避胡人去了。
金鞭都抽断了，九匹御马也都累死，
亲骨肉也等不及一同奔驰逃难。
那王孙腰下系着青珊瑚玉佩，
可怜他正在路边角落里哭泣。
问他是谁，他也不肯说出姓名，
只说自己困苦不堪，请求做别人的奴仆。
他已经在荆棘丛中逃窜了一百多天，
身上没有一块完好的肌肤。
汉高祖的子孙都长着高鼻梁，
龙种自然与平常人长得不一样。
豺狼在城中盘踞，龙种却在荒野流落，
王孙啊，你要好好保重千金之躯。
我不敢在大路口和你长谈，
只能暂时为你在路边停留片刻。
昨夜东风吹来阵阵血腥气味，
从东边来的骆驼挤满了旧都长安。
北方的健儿个个身手不凡，
往日何等勇猛，如今却如此愚钝。
我私下听说天子已经传位给肃宗，
圣德贤明已使北方的南单于降服归心。
花门的回纥人割面流血请求洗雪国耻，
你千万不要乱说，小心有人暗中暗算。
可悲啊，王孙你千万不要疏忽大意，
五陵的帝王佳气永远不会消失。

title: 天末怀李白
author: 杜甫
note: 【君子】古代对有德行者的尊称，亦指地位显贵之人。；【天末怀李白】唐代杜甫所作的诗。

en_body: A cold wind rises at the edge of heaven,
How fare you, my friend, in this far-off place?
When will the wild geese bring your letters?
The rivers and lakes swell with autumn waters, full of peril.
Literary genius has ever hated a fortunate fate,
And mountain demons await the traveler who passes their way.
You must be speaking now with the wronged soul of Qu Yuan,
Casting your poems as offerings into the Miluo River.

title: 奉济驿重送严公四韵
author: 杜甫

The green hills alone look on with fruitless affection.
When shall we raise our cups together again?
Last night we walked together in the moonlight.
Through every commandery people sing your praise, lamenting your departure,
Three reigns you served, honored whether at court or abroad.
I shall return alone to my riverside village,
To live out my remaining days in solitude.

en_translation: I escort you far and here we must part,
The green hills alone look on with fruitless affection.
When shall we raise our cups together again?
Last night we walked together in the moonlight.
Through every commandery people sing your praise, lamenting your departure,
Three reigns you served, honored whether at court or abroad.
I shall return alone to my riverside village,
To live out my remaining days in solitude.

昨夜我们还在月光下同行。

我独自回到江边的村舍，
将在寂寞中度过残年余生。

author: 杜甫

en_body: North and south of my cottage spring waters flood,
Day after day I see only flocks of gulls arriving.
The flower-strewn path has never been swept for any guest,
And my wicker gate opens today for you alone.
Far from the market, my plate holds but simple fare,
In this poor household, the wine is only old and unstrained.
If you would care to drink with the old man next door,
I'll call across the hedge and bid him come finish the cup.

title: 寄韩谏议注
author: 杜甫
note: 【长安】汉唐都城，在今陕西西安，诗词中常借指帝都、理想之地。；【寄韩谏议注】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 今我不乐思岳阳，身欲奋飞病在床。美人娟娟隔秋水，濯足洞庭望八荒。鸿飞冥冥日月白，青枫叶赤天雨霜。玉京群帝集北斗，或骑麒麟翳凤凰。芙蓉旌旗烟雾落，影动倒景摇潇湘。星宫之君醉琼浆，羽人稀少不在旁。似闻昨者赤松子，恐是汉代韩张良。昔随刘氏定长安，帷幄未改神惨伤。国家成败吾岂敢，色难腥腐餐枫香。周南留滞古所惜，南极老人应寿昌。美人胡为隔秋水，焉得置之贡玉堂？

en_body: Today I am heavy of heart and think of distant Yueyang,
I long to soar there on wings, but illness keeps me bedridden.
A fair and noble one stands graceful beyond the autumn waters,
Washing his feet in Dongting Lake, gazing out over the wilds.
The swan flies high into the distance, sun and moon shine bright,
Green maple leaves turn red as frost falls from the sky.
The assembled emperors of Jade Capital gather at the Dipper,
Some riding unicorns, others borne aloft on phoenixes.
Lotus banners drift downward through mist and fog,
Their reflections shimmering in the Xiao and Xiang rivers.
The lords of the star palaces grow drunk on nectar wine,
While feathered immortals grow few and stand no longer at their side.
Methinks I hear of the immortal Master Red Pine of old,
Perhaps he is none other than Zhang Liang of Han who retired in time.
Once he followed Liu Bang to conquer Chang'an and build the empire,
Yet his strategic heart remains unchanged though his spirit is grieved.
How dare I turn away from the fortunes or failures of the state?
Yet I sicken at the stench of corruption and would dine on maple incense instead.
To be stranded at Zhounan as Sima Qian was, the ancients lamented,
But the Old Man of the South Star promises longevity and peace.
Fair one, why do you remain beyond the autumn waters?
How may I see you brought to serve in the Jade Hall once more?

baihua_lines: 今天我心情不好，思念起遥远的岳阳，
想要奋飞前往，却无奈卧病在床。
有一位品行美好的君子，隔着盈盈秋水，风姿绰约，
他在洞庭湖中洗脚，遥望着八方荒野。
鸿鹄高飞远走，日月皎洁明亮，
青枫树叶已经变红，天降寒霜。
玉京的诸位天帝聚集在北斗星旁，
有的骑着麒麟，有的乘着凤凰。
芙蓉做的旌旗在烟雾中落下，
影子倒映在潇湘水中随波摇动。
星宫中的帝君沉醉在琼浆玉液里，
那些飞仙羽客稀少，没有陪侍在身旁。
我好像听说从前那位仙人赤松子，
恐怕就是汉代那位功成身退的张良。
当年他跟随刘邦平定长安建立功业，
如今虽已隐居，运筹帷幄之心未改，神色却惨然悲伤。
国家的成败兴衰我怎么敢置身事外？
只是厌恶那腥腐的世道，想要归隐山林餐食枫香。
像太史公那样滞留周南是古人都惋惜的事，
那南极老人星的出现正预示着天下太平昌盛。
那位美好的君子啊，你为什么要远隔秋水？
怎样才能把你安置到朝堂之上，为国效力呢？

author: 杜甫

Beneath a tall mast, alone in the night my boat is moored.
Stars hang low over the vast, level plain,
The moon surges up as the great river flows on.

en_body: As dusk falls, flowers are dim along the palace walls,
Chirping birds flit past on their way to roost.
Stars twinkle above, stirring over ten thousand gates,
The moon shines brightest by the highest halls of heaven.
Sleepless I lie, listening for the sound of golden keys in locks,
And the wind makes me think of jade bridle-bells at court.
At dawn I have a sealed memorial to present,

en_body: The kingdom is broken, yet mountains and rivers remain,
Spring comes to the city where grass and trees grow thick and deep.
Grieving for the times, even blossoms bring tears to my eyes,
Resenting this separation, birdsong shocks my heart.
Beacon fires have blazed for three months unceasing,
A letter from home is worth ten thousand pieces of gold.
My white hair, scratched, grows ever thinner,
Until it can scarce hold the pin that fastens my cap.

en_body: What is Taishan Mountain like, I wonder?
Across Qi and Lu its green stretches endlessly into the distance.

Layered clouds well up and stir my breast,
My eyes strain to follow birds returning to their nests.
One day I shall climb to its very summit,
And look down upon all the mountains, grown small below.

title: 梦李白·其一
author: 杜甫
note: 【江南】长江以南地区，以水乡风光、温婉秀丽著称。；【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。
tr: 死别已吞声，生别常恻恻。江南瘴疠地，逐客无消息。故人入我梦，明我长相忆。恐非平生魂，路远不可测。魂来枫林青，魂返关塞黑。君今在罗网，何以有羽翼？落月满屋梁，犹疑照颜色。水深波浪阔，无使蛟龙得。

en_body: Death brings parting we bear with muffled sobs,
But parting from the living fills us with endless grief.
To the malarial lands south of the Yangtze,
You, the exile, have sent no word at all.
My old friend came into my dream last night,
Because you know how constantly I long for you.
I fear this may not be your living soul,
The road is so long—who can know if you live or die?
Your spirit came through green maple forests,
And returned across dark and gloomy frontier passes.
Now you are caught in the net of exile,
How did you find wings to fly to me?
Waking, the setting moon casts its light across the beams,
And I seem still to see your face in its glow.
Deep are the waters, wide the waves on your return journey,
Do not let the river dragons seize you.

author: 杜甫
note: 【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。；【梦李白·其二】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 浮云终日行，游子久不至。三夜频梦君，情亲见君意。告归常局促，苦道来不易。江湖多风波，舟楫恐失坠。出门搔白首，若负平生志。冠盖满京华，斯人独憔悴。孰云网恢恢，将老身反累。千秋万岁名，寂寞身后事。
appr: 《梦李白·其二》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《梦李白·其二》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: Floating clouds drift across the sky all day,
Yet the wanderer has not returned for so long.
Three nights in a row I have dreamed of you,
So deeply does your friendship touch my heart.
Each time you took your leave you seemed so ill at ease,
Sighing again and again how hard it was to come.
Rivers and lakes are full of storms and perils,
I fear your boat may overturn in the waves.
Leaving, you scratch your white head,
As if your lifelong ambitions had been betrayed.
The capital is full of high officials in their carriages,
Yet you alone are worn and gaunt with care.
Who says the net of heaven is wide and just?
Approaching old age, you are entangled in misfortune.
Your name will last a thousand autumns, ten thousand years,
But after death comes only silence and neglect.

baihua_lines: 天上的浮云终日飘来飘去，
远行的游子却久久不能归来。
接连三个夜晚我都频频梦到你，
足见你对我的情意是多么深厚。
每次梦中你告辞归去时都局促不安，
苦苦地说来一趟太不容易。
江湖上风波迭起险恶多端，
我的朋友，我总担心你的船会失事倾覆。
出门时你搔着满头白发，
仿佛辜负了你平生的凌云壮志。
京城里高冠华盖的权贵挤满了街道，
唯独你这样的人才落得憔悴困顿。
谁说天道公平、法网恢恢？
你都快到老了反倒被牵连获罪。
千秋万代之后你的大名定会流传千古，
只是你死后注定寂寞凄凉。

title: 江南逢李龟年
author: 杜甫
note: 【江南】长江以南地区，以水乡风光、温婉秀丽著称。；【江南逢李龟年】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 岐王宅里寻常见。崔九堂前几度闻。正是江南好风景。落花时节又逢君。

Playful butterflies linger and dance from bloom to bloom,
While free and easy orioles sing their pretty songs.
baihua_lines: 黄四娘家周围的小路上开满了缤纷的鲜花，
千朵万朵沉甸甸地把花枝都压弯了。
嬉闹的蝴蝶在花丛中恋恋不舍地盘旋飞舞，
自由自在的黄莺叫声和谐动听。

en_body: Long have I heard of Dongting Lake,
Today I finally climb Yueyang Tower.
Its vast waters split Wu and Chu to east and south,
Heaven and earth seem to float upon its surface day and night.
Not a single word comes from kith or kin,
Old and sick, I have only this lonely boat.
War horses still rage north of the mountain passes,
Leaning on the rail, I cannot hold back my tears.

en_body: Flowers blooming near the high tower wound the traveler's heart,
Amid troubles on every side I climb this lofty building.
Spring colors from the Jin River come flooding between earth and sky,
Clouds over Yulei Mountain shift and change through past and present.
The imperial court, like the North Star, will never alter,
Let the mountain bandits dare not invade again.
Pitiable that the last ruler of Shu still has his temple,
As evening falls I chant the Liangfu Song once more.

日暮时分我姑且吟唱一曲《梁甫吟》。

en_body: The wind is keen, the sky is high, and apes cry mournfully,
Over clear islets of white sand birds circle and wheel.
Endlessly, leaves from the forest shower down rustling,
And the endless Yangtze comes rolling in great waves.
Ten thousand li from home, grieving autumn, forever a wanderer,
Sickly through my life, today I climb this terrace alone.
Hardship and bitterness have frosted my hair with regret,
Worn and defeated, I have just set aside my cup of wine.

background: 《登高》为唐代杜甫所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者杜甫在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: The wind is keen, the sky is high, and apes cry mournfully,
Over clear islets of white sand birds circle and wheel.
Endlessly, leaves from the forest shower down rustling,
And the endless Yangtze comes rolling in great waves.
Ten thousand li from home, grieving autumn, forever a wanderer,
Sickly through my life, today I climb this terrace alone.
Hardship and bitterness have frosted my hair with regret,
Worn and defeated, I have just set aside my cup of wine.

无边无际的林木落叶萧萧落下，

困顿潦倒中，我刚刚停下了浇愁的酒杯。

title: 绝句
author: 杜甫

title: 至德二载甫自京金光门出
author: 杜甫
note: 【至德二载甫自京金光门出】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 此道昔歸順，西郊胡正繁。至今殘破膽，應有未招魂。近得歸京邑，移官豈至尊。無才日衰老，駐馬望千門。

en_body: This is the road by which I fled Chang'an to join the throne,
When the western suburbs swarmed with rebel troops.
Even now the memory makes my heart tremble still,
How many souls then were lost, never to return?
Recently I was able to come back to the capital,
But this transfer can hardly be the emperor's own will.
Without talent, growing older and feebler by the day,
I rein in my horse and gaze back at the thousand gates, lingering.

en_body: Where shall I find the temple of the Prime Minister of Shu?
Outside Chengdu, where cypress trees grow dense and dark.
Green grasses grow wild by the steps, greeting spring in vain,
Hidden among the leaves, orioles pour out their songs to empty air.
Three visits to the cottage sought your counsel for the empire,
You served two reigns, pouring forth an old minister's loyal heart.
But before victory could be won in the northern campaigns, you died in camp,
And heroes through the ages have wet their robes with tears.

Outside Chengdu, where cypress trees grow dense and dark.
Green grasses grow wild by the steps, greeting spring in vain,
Hidden among the leaves, orioles pour out their songs to empty air.
Three visits to the cottage sought your counsel for the empire,
You served two reigns, pouring forth an old minister's loyal heart.
But before victory could be won in the northern campaigns, you died in camp,
And heroes through the ages have wet their robes with tears.
baihua_lines: 诸葛丞相的祠堂去哪里寻找？
就在成都城外那柏树茂密的地方。
台阶前的碧草空自呈现出一片春色，
藏在树叶间的黄鹂白白地唱着婉转的歌。
先主刘备三顾茅庐，多次向你请教统一天下的大计，
你辅佐两朝开国继业，捧出了老臣的一片忠心。
可惜出师伐魏还没取得胜利你就先病死军中了，
常使后代的英雄们泪满衣襟。

title: 观公孙大娘弟子舞剑器行
author: 杜甫
note: 【观公孙大娘弟子舞剑器行】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 昔有佳人公孫氏，一舞劒氣動四方。觀者如山色沮喪，天地爲之久低昂。㸌如羿射九日落，矯如羣帝驂龍翔。來如雷霆收震怒，罷如江海凝清光。絳脣珠袖兩寂莫，況有弟子傳芬芳。臨潁美人在白帝，妙舞此曲神揚揚。與余問答既有以，感時撫事增惋傷。先帝侍女八千人，公孫劒器初第一。五十年間似反掌，風塵傾動昏王室。棃園子弟散如煙，女樂餘姿映寒日。金粟堆南木已拱，瞿唐石城草蕭瑟。玳筵急管曲復終，樂極哀來月東出。老夫不知其所往，足繭荒山轉愁疾。
appr: 《观公孙大娘弟子舞剑器行》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共26句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《观公孙大娘弟子舞剑器行》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: There was once a beauty named Madame Gongsun,
Whose sword dance moved all the realm with its power.
Onlookers gathered like mountains, their faces pale with awe,
As heaven and earth themselves seemed to heave and sway before her.
Her blade flashed like Hou Yi shooting down nine suns,
Her steps soared like gods riding dragons through the sky.
She came like thunder holding back its wrath,
And ended like river and sea stilled in clear light.
Red lips and pearled sleeves have long fallen silent,
But a disciple has carried on her fragrant art.
This beauty from Linying is here at White Emperor City,
Dancing this same tune with spirit high and bright.
We spoke together, and she told me of the old days,
Making me mourn the past and sigh for the present.
The late emperor had eight thousand palace maids,
And Madame Gongsun's sword dance was the first among them.
Fifty years have passed in the turning of a hand,
As wind and dust of war engulfed the royal house.
Pear Garden pupils scattered like smoke,
While lingering grace of female dancers shines in the cold sun.
By the Golden Millet Mound trees have grown thick around the tomb,
At Qutang Gorge's Stone City grass sere and dry.
The feast and urgent music come to an end,
Joy turns to sorrow as the moon rises in the east.
This old man knows not where he is going,
Blisters on his feet, wandering the barren hills, grief-stricken and slow.

en_title: 观公孙大娘弟子舞剑器行
baihua_lines: 从前有位美人叫公孙大娘，
她舞起剑来，气概惊动四方。
围观的人群如山一样，都大惊失色，
天地都为她的舞姿久久起伏低昂。
剑光闪烁，像后羿射落九个太阳，
舞姿矫健，如群仙驾着龙在飞翔。
起舞时如雷霆收住震怒，
收舞时像江海凝聚着清光。
当年的绛唇珠袖早已沉寂无闻，
幸好有弟子把她的技艺传承流芳。
临颍的美人李十二娘就在白帝城，
她舞动这支曲子神采飞扬。
她和我交谈问答，讲了许多往事，
让我抚今追昔，更添惋惜伤感。
先帝玄宗的侍女有八千人，
公孙大娘的剑器舞当初数第一。
五十年光阴流逝，快如反掌，
战乱风尘动摇了大唐王室。
梨园弟子们如烟散去，
女乐师的余姿在寒日下掩映。
金粟堆前玄宗陵墓的树木已经合抱粗了，
瞿塘峡口的白帝城草木萧瑟。
盛宴上急促的乐曲已经奏完，
乐极生悲，月亮已从东方升起。
我这个老夫不知道该往哪里去，
在荒山上磨出了老茧，满怀愁绪走得反而迟缓。

title: 赠卫八处士
author: 杜甫
note: 【君子】古代对有德行者的尊称，亦指地位显贵之人。；【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
tr: 人生不相見，動如參與商。今夕復何夕，共此燈燭光。少壯能幾時，鬢髮各已蒼。訪舊半爲鬼，驚呼熱中腸。焉知二十載，重上君子堂。昔別君未婚，兒女忽成行。怡然敬父執，問我來何方。問荅乃未已，兒女羅酒漿。夜雨剪春韭，新炊間黃粱。主稱會面難，一舉累十觴。十觴亦不醉，感子故意長。明日隔山岳，世事兩茫茫。
appr: 《赠卫八处士》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《赠卫八处士》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: In this life friends so rarely meet,
Like the stars Shen and Shang that never share the sky.
What a blessed evening this is,
That we should gather again by the light of this same lamp.
How long does youth and vigor last?
Before we know it, the hair at our temples has turned gray.
Asking after old friends, half have become ghosts,
I cry out in shock, my heart wrung with pain.
Who would have thought that after twenty years apart,
I would once again step into your hall?
When we parted last you were not yet married,
Now suddenly your sons and daughters stand in a row.
They greet their father's old friend with gentle kindness,
Asking me where I have come from.
Before our questions and answers have ended,
The children have set out wine and dishes.
They cut spring chives in the night rain,
And serve freshly steamed yellow millet rice.
Our host says such meetings are rare indeed,
And raises cup after cup—ten cups in one draught.
After ten cups I am still not drunk,
Moved by your deep and lasting friendship.
Tomorrow mountains will separate us once more,
And the ways of the world will carry us each into the unknown.

en_translation: In this life friends so rarely meet,
Like the stars Shen and Shang that never share the sky.
What a blessed evening this is,
That we should gather again by the light of this same lamp.
How long does youth and vigor last?
Before we know it, the hair at our temples has turned gray.
Asking after old friends, half have become ghosts,
I cry out in shock, my heart wrung with pain.
Who would have thought that after twenty years apart,
I would once again step into your hall?
When we parted last you were not yet married,
Now suddenly your sons and daughters stand in a row.
They greet their father's old friend with gentle kindness,
Asking me where I have come from.
Before our questions and answers have ended,
The children have set out wine and dishes.
They cut spring chives in the night rain,
And serve freshly steamed yellow millet rice.
Our host says such meetings are rare indeed,
And raises cup after cup—ten cups in one draught.
After ten cups I am still not drunk,
Moved by your deep and lasting friendship.
Tomorrow mountains will separate us once more,
And the ways of the world will carry us each into the unknown.
baihua_lines: 人生在世，朋友之间常常难以相见，
就像天上的参星和商星，此起彼落永不能相见。
今晚是什么样的好日子啊，
我们竟能一同在这灯烛光下相聚。
少壮年华能持续多久呢？
转眼间你我都已鬓发苍苍。
询问旧日亲友，大半都已去世成了鬼魂，
我失声惊呼，心中绞痛不已。
哪里想到分别二十年之后，
我还能重新登上你家的厅堂。
当年分别时你还没有成婚，
忽然间你已经儿女成行。
他们和颜悦色地礼敬父亲的老朋友，
问我是从什么地方来的。
问答的话还没有说完，
孩子们已经摆上了酒浆菜肴。
夜雨里剪来了春天的韭菜，
刚蒸好的黄粱米饭散发着香气。
主人说难得见上一面，
连连举杯劝酒，一口气喝了十杯。
喝了十杯也没有醉意，
感谢你对老朋友的情深意长。
明天我们又要被山岳隔开，
世事茫茫，后会难期。

title: 野望
author: 杜甫
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【野望】唐代杜甫所作的诗。

en_body: North of Jinhua Mountain, west of the Fu River,
The wind and sun of midwinter have turned cold and drear.
Mountains stretch to Yuexi, coiling across the three Shu lands,
The waters spread through Bayu down to the Five Streams.
A lone crane dances for reasons I cannot know,
Hungry crows seem about to cry out to passersby.
Shehong spring wine remains green even in the cold,
I gaze until my spirit is sore—who will drink with me?

baihua_lines: 金华山北面，涪水西边，
仲冬时节的风和日色已开始变得凄冷。
群山连绵连接越巂，蟠踞在三蜀大地，
涪江水散入巴渝，一直流向五溪。
孤鹤不知为了什么事在空中飞舞，
饥饿的乌鸦好像要对着人啼叫。
射洪的春酒即使天寒也依旧碧绿，
极目远望令人伤神，谁能伴我同饮呢？

title: 闻官军收河南河北
author: 杜甫
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【闻官军收河南河北】唐代杜甫所作的诗。

en_body: Beyond Sword Gate suddenly word came: Jibei has been recovered!
When I first heard it, tears soaked through my clothes.
I turn to look at wife and children—no trace of sorrow remains,
I roll up my poems and books wildly, nearly mad with joy.
In broad daylight I sing loudly and must drink deep,
With spring as my companion, I shall set out for home at once.
Straightaway through Ba Gorge we shall pass through Wu Gorge,
Downriver past Xiangyang, heading straight for Luoyang.

When I first heard it, tears soaked through my clothes.
I turn to look at wife and children—no trace of sorrow remains,
I roll up my poems and books wildly, nearly mad with joy.
In broad daylight I sing loudly and must drink deep,
With spring as my companion, I shall set out for home at once.
Straightaway through Ba Gorge we shall pass through Wu Gorge,
Downriver past Xiangyang, heading straight for Luoyang.

title: 阁夜
author: 杜甫
note: 【天涯】天的尽头，指极远之地，常与漂泊、相思相连。；【阁夜】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 歲暮陰陽催短景，天涯霜雪霽寒宵。五更鼓角聲悲壯，三峽星河影動搖。野哭幾家聞戰伐，夷歌數處起漁樵。臥龍躍馬終黃土，人事依依漫寂寥。
appr: 《阁夜》是唐代杜甫所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《阁夜》历代传诵不衰，是杜甫诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: At year's end the days grow ever shorter,
A wanderer at the world's end on a frosty night when snow has cleared.
At the fifth watch, bugles and drums sound with tragic grandeur,
Over the Three Gorges, star reflections tremble on the river.
From the wilderness come the cries of households—news of war's toll,
And fishermen and woodcutters sing barbarian songs here and there.
Sleeping Dragon and Prancing Horse alike have turned to dust at last,
Human affairs drift by, letters cease, leaving only vast solitude.

浪迹天涯的我在霜雪初停的寒夜里难以入眠。
五更时分，军营的鼓角声分外悲壮，
三峡之上，星河的倒影在江面上摇曳。
荒野中传来几家哭声，是战祸带来的消息，
几处渔人和樵夫唱起了夷地的歌谣。
诸葛亮和公孙述那样的英雄人物终究化为黄土，
人事变迁，音书断绝，只剩下无边的寂寞。

title: 韦讽录事宅观曹将军画马图
author: 杜甫
body: 君不见金粟堆前松柏里，
note: 【韦讽录事宅观曹将军画马图】唐代杜甫所作的诗。
tr: 國初已來畫鞍馬，神妙獨數江都王。將軍得名三十載，人間又見真乘黃。曾貌先帝照夜白，龍池十日飛霹靂。內府殷紅馬腦盌，倢伃傳詔才人索。盌賜將軍拜舞歸，輕紈細綺相追飛。貴戚權門得筆跡，始覺屏障生光輝。昔日太宗拳毛騧，近時郭家師子花。今之新圖有二馬，復令識者久歎嗟。此皆騎戰一敵萬，縞素漠漠開風沙。其餘七匹亦殊絕，迥若寒空動煙雪。霜蹄蹴踏長楸間，馬官廝養森成列。可憐九馬爭神駿，顧視清高氣深穩。借問苦心愛者誰，後有韋諷前支遁。憶昔巡幸新豐宮，翠華拂天來向東。騰驤磊落三萬匹，皆與此圖筋骨同。自從獻寶朝河宗，無復射蛟江水中。君不見金粟堆前松柏裏，龍媒去盡鳥呼風。

en_body: Since the founding of the dynasty, among painters of saddle horses,
The most divine and marvelous was the Prince of Jiangdu.
The General has been famous now for thirty years,
And once again true celestial steeds appear among men.
Once you painted the late emperor's horse Zhaoyebai,
And for ten days thunder seemed to fly above the Dragon Pool.
From the inner treasury came a deep-red agate bowl,
As palace ladies brought edicts requesting your work.
When the bowl was bestowed, you bowed and danced your thanks,
While fine silks for painting were sent in swift pursuit.
When nobles and powerful houses obtained your brushwork,
They felt their screens and walls at last begin to glow.
Long ago there was Taizong's horse Quanmaogua,
And more recently Guo Ziyi's steed Shizihua.
In this new painting you have captured both these horses,
Making connoisseurs sigh in admiration long and deep.
These were war horses each worth a thousand ordinary mounts,
And on the white silk they seem to kick up endless desert sand.
The other seven horses are also extraordinarily fine,
Distant as smoke or snow drifting across the cold sky.
Their frosted hooves trot among the catalpa trees,
While grooms and stable attendants stand in neat array.
How the nine horses vie to show their divine mettle,
With noble gaze, their spirits deep and steady.
Who are those who love horses with such devotion?
After Zhidun of old, we now have Wei Feng.
I recall when the emperor toured Xinfeng Palace,
His emerald standards swept the sky as he came eastward.
Thirty thousand prancing, galloping steeds came with him,
And all had the same fine bone as those in this painting.
Since the emperor offered treasures and departed this world,
No more do we see him shooting dragons in the river.
Have you not seen? Among the pines before the Golden Millet Mound,
All the dragon steeds have gone—only birds cry in the wind.

en_title: 韦讽录事宅观曹将军画马图
baihua_lines: 开国以来擅长画鞍马的名家，
最神妙的得数江都王李绪。
曹将军得名已有三十个年头，
人间又重见了真正的神马乘黄。
你曾经画过先帝的御马照夜白，
画成后龙池之上十天都仿佛有霹雳飞腾。
内府珍藏的殷红玛瑙碗，
妃嫔传诏才人奉旨向你索求画作。
玛瑙碗赐给将军，你拜谢舞蹈而归，
轻纨细绮做的画料接连不断地追送到家。
贵戚权门得到了你的笔迹，
才觉得家中的屏风屏障生出了光辉。
从前唐太宗的御马拳毛騧，
近时郭子仪的坐骑狮子花。
你这幅新画里画了这两匹名马，
让识货的人久久赞叹不已。
这都是战阵上身抵万骑的骏马，
在白绢上一展画纸就像漠漠风沙铺开。
其余七匹马也都画得绝妙非凡，
远远看去像寒空中飘动的烟霞白雪。
带霜的蹄子在长楸道间踏步行走，
马官和役卒们排列得整整齐齐。
可爱这九匹马争相显示各自的神骏，
它们顾盼间气宇清高，气质深沉稳重。
请问苦心爱马的人是谁呢？
前有支遁，后有你韦讽啊。
回忆当年先帝巡幸新丰宫时，
翠华仪仗拂天蔽日向东而来。
腾跃奔驰的骏马有三万匹之多，
都和这幅图上的骏马筋骨相同。
自从玄宗皇帝仙逝之后，
再也看不到皇帝射蛟于江中的盛事了。
你难道没看见金粟堆前的松柏林里，
神骏的天马都已离去，只有鸟儿在风中啼鸣。
baihua: 开国以来擅长画鞍马的名家，最神妙的得数江都王李绪。曹将军得名已有三十个年头，人间又重见了真正的神马乘黄。你曾经画过先帝的御马照夜白，画成后龙池之上十天都仿佛有霹雳飞腾。内府珍藏的殷红玛瑙碗，妃嫔传诏才人奉旨向你索求画作。玛瑙碗赐给将军，你拜谢舞蹈而归，轻纨细绮做的画料接连不断地追送到家。贵戚权门得到了你的笔迹，才觉得家中的屏风屏障生出了光辉。从前唐太宗的御马拳毛騧，近时郭子仪的坐骑狮子花。你这幅新画里画了这两匹名马，让识货的人久久赞叹不已。这都是战阵上身抵万骑的骏马，在白绢上一展画纸就像漠漠风沙铺开。其余七匹马也都画得绝妙非凡，远远看去像寒空中飘动的烟霞白雪。带霜的蹄子在长楸道间踏步行走，马官和役卒们排列得整整齐齐。可爱这九匹马争相显示各自的神骏，它们顾盼间气宇清高，气质深沉稳重。请问苦心爱马的人是谁呢？前有支遁，后有你韦讽啊。回忆当年先帝巡幸新丰宫时，翠华仪仗拂天蔽日向东而来。腾跃奔驰的骏马有三万匹之多，都和这幅图上的骏马筋骨相同。自从玄宗皇帝仙逝之后，再也看不到皇帝射蛟于江中的盛事了。你难道没看见金粟堆前的松柏林里，神骏的天马都已离去，只有鸟儿在风中啼鸣。
en_lines: Since the founding of the dynasty, among painters of saddle horses,
The most divine and marvelous was the Prince of Jiangdu.
The General has been famous now for thirty years,
And once again true celestial steeds appear among men.
Once you painted the late emperor's horse Zhaoyebai,
And for ten days thunder seemed to fly above the Dragon Pool.
From the inner treasury came a deep-red agate bowl,
As palace ladies brought edicts requesting your work.
When the bowl was bestowed, you bowed and danced your thanks,
While fine silks for painting were sent in swift pursuit.
When nobles and powerful houses obtained your brushwork,
They felt their screens and walls at last begin to glow.
Long ago there was Taizong's horse Quanmaogua,
And more recently Guo Ziyi's steed Shizihua.
In this new painting you have captured both these horses,
Making connoisseurs sigh in admiration long and deep.
These were war horses each worth a thousand ordinary mounts,
And on the white silk they seem to kick up endless desert sand.
The other seven horses are also extraordinarily fine,
Distant as smoke or snow drifting across the cold sky.
Their frosted hooves trot among the catalpa trees,
While grooms and stable attendants stand in neat array.
How the nine horses vie to show their divine mettle,
With noble gaze, their spirits deep and steady.
Who are those who love horses with such devotion?
After Zhidun of old, we now have Wei Feng.
I recall when the emperor toured Xinfeng Palace,
His emerald standards swept the sky as he came eastward.
Thirty thousand prancing, galloping steeds came with him,
And all had the same fine bone as those in this painting.
Since the emperor offered treasures and departed this world,
No more do we see him shooting dragons in the river.
Have you not seen? Among the pines before the Golden Millet Mound,
All the dragon steeds have gone—only birds cry in the wind.

title: 金缕衣
author: 杜秋娘
note: 《金缕衣》是杜秋娘的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【金缕衣】唐代杜秋娘所作的诗。

en_body: Early I was chosen for my beauty, and by beauty was betrayed,
I would adorn myself, yet facing the mirror feel too weary.
Imperial favor is not bestowed for looks alone,
So why should I strive to make myself fair?
In the warm spring wind, bird cries chatter and dart,
As the sun rises high, flower shadows fall thick and deep.
Year after year I think of the girls by Yue Stream,
Recalling how we gathered lotus flowers together.

en_body: I draw well water to rinse my cold teeth,
Purify my mind and brush the dust from my robes.
At leisure I take up the sutras written on palm leaves,
And stroll out from the eastern study to read them.
The true source men do not grasp at all,
While vain traces are what the world pursues.
The Buddha's last words I hope to fathom in silence,
But how may I cultivate my nature to full maturity?
The monk's courtyard is still and quiet,
Mossy green stretches deep among the bamboo.
The sun rises, mist and dew still lingering,
Green pines glisten as if anointed with oil.
Serene and detached, beyond the reach of words,
The joy of enlightenment fills the heart with contentment.

清净心神，掸去衣服上的尘土。
闲来手持贝叶经书，
信步走出东斋诵读。
佛经的真谛世人全然不知汲取，
那些虚妄的迹相反被世人追逐不已。
佛祖的遗言希望能在冥冥中领悟，

悟道的喜悦油然而生，内心自足。

background: 《渔翁》为唐代柳宗元所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者柳宗元在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: The fisherman moors at night by the western cliffs,
At dawn he draws clear Xiang water and burns Chu bamboo to cook.
Mist lifts, the sun comes out—yet no man is seen,
At the creak of oars, green hills and waters come alive.
Looking back, his boat drifts down from the edge of sky,
While white clouds above the cliffs chase one another, free and aimless.
baihua_lines: 渔翁夜晚靠着西山的岩石歇宿，
清晨汲取清澈的湘水，点燃楚地的竹子做饭。
烟消雾散太阳出来，渔翁却不见了人影，
只听得欸乃一声橹响，青山绿水顿时显现。
回头看去，渔舟已从天际顺流而下，
岩上的白云自由自在地互相追逐。

title: 溪居
author: 柳宗元
note: 《溪居》是柳宗元的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【溪居】唐代柳宗元所作的诗。
tr: 久爲簪組累，幸此南夷謫。閑依農圃鄰，偶似山林客。曉耕翻露草，夜榜響溪石。來往不逢人，長歌楚天碧。

en_body: Too long I was bound by the shackles of official life,
Fortunately exiled to these southern wilds, I find leisure at last.
In idleness I dwell beside farms and vegetable plots,
Sometimes feeling like a hermit of the woods and hills.
At dawn I plow, turning dew-damp grass,
At night I pole my boat back, oars knocking against stones in the stream.
Coming and going I meet no worldly travelers,
I sing aloud as I gaze at the clear blue sky of Chu.

baihua_lines: 长久以来被官场上的官职所束缚牵累，
幸好这次被贬到南夷之地，倒得清闲。
闲时就到菜圃农田旁和农家为邻，
偶尔也像个山林隐逸之士。
清晨耕田，翻带着露水的野草，
夜晚划船归来，船桨碰响溪中的石头。
来来往往都遇不到世俗的人，
我放声长歌，楚地的天空碧蓝如洗。

title: 登柳州城楼寄漳汀封连四州刺史
author: 柳宗元
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【登柳州城楼寄漳汀封连四州刺史】唐代柳宗元所作的诗。

en_body: From the high tower of Liuzhou I gaze over the vast wilderness,
My sorrows stretch boundless as sea and sky.
Gusting winds churn the waters where lotus grows,
Driving rain slants against the walls covered in climbing figs.
Ridge trees rise in layers, blocking my view for a thousand li,
The river twists and turns like knotted bowels of grief.
We were all sent to this tattooed land of the hundred Yue tribes,
Yet still our letters cannot reach one another, stranded each in our own corner.

像海天一样茫茫无际的愁思涌上心头。
急风胡乱地吹动着长满荷花的水面，
密雨斜打在爬满薜荔的墙上。
岭上的树木重重叠叠，遮住了千里之外的视线，
江流弯弯曲曲，如同九转的愁肠。
我们一同被贬到这百越纹身之地，
却依旧音书不通，各自滞留在一方。
